text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nghahhh! So many waifus w-wishing me a happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want to remember all of it so bad I've
barely
blinked! Ahh, my memory's fried!
I can't!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-are you all right? Do you feel sick?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I think she feels overwhelmed. Must be a
case of
my aura shining too bright...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
AHH! It's the peak ship! I mean, hey
Doto and
Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm just fine. Nothing to worry about! I
was just
running a liiittle over capacity
for a bit!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Not sure I understand,
but... Ah, I
know!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall gift you a few words in my silvery
voice!
That ought to reinvigorate you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Without further adieu... Happy birthday,
Digital!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-oh no! Sh-she's become a statue!
